primary_metric.name: correctly accepted absolute camera poses / all eligible positive pairs

requirements.original_target: At least 70% correctly accepted camera poses / all eligible positive pairs.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: The full-library saved outputs permit at most 114/192 correctly accepted, even with perfect rejection. A 192-positive cohort needs at least 135 correct poses for 70%. The 12-light ceiling is 86/192. Final and calibrated acceptance remain open.

requirements.original_target: At least 10 percentage points accepted-pose gain versus strongest matched compact control, including deterministic refinement.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: The five-arm compact bootstrap recovered the same one of four poses in each arm. Direct relighting outperformed two matched full-development controls, which does not establish an accepted-pose compact gain.

Both libraries returned 0/192 raw nonoverlap poses on repeated terrain endpoints. The illustrative independent-case one-sided 95% bound is 1.55%. Full-library wrong positive outputs were 18/132 and the 12-light library 26/112. Separate calibration and frozen evaluation remain open.

requirements.original_target: Modern pose accuracy advantage, or within 3 percentage points correct acceptance and at least 5× faster on same CPU at comparable error.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: The completed same-case modern comparison is MatchAnything. LIMA, Wang et al., MOONSt3R, WARG, REDI-Match and RoMa-Ω use different priors, outcomes or hardware. The eight-case ARM qualification for LoMa-R and RoMa v2 passes preflight and still needs dispatch. Same-worker direct/candidate comparison remains required for an efficiency claim.

original_target.train_lights: even indices only, including teacher targets

requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: All 96 camera units and 192 exact pose controls are complete, with 16 training groups, eight selection groups and even-only training lights.

requirements.original_target: Implement and evaluate shared-Sun joint inference (A), learned lighting response (B), and active patch selection (C), all eight on/off combinations.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: All eight integrated module combinations, pooled and active-policy controls, 32/64/128 budgets and fair supplied-Sun track remain required. The new nearest-even and two-reference template control has a native synthetic SIFT/pose check. Metadata qualifies all 128 odd-light positives and 72/128 odd-light negatives for a two-reference bracket. The separate 48-case supplied-Sun pilot is prepared, with 24 common-supported positives and 14 common-supported nonoverlaps. No lunar inference has run.

requirements.original_target: 100-update exact replay/cost pilot, then 2,000 updates with seed 20261101; evaluate 0/500/1000/1500/2000.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: The exact 100-update replays and 2,000-update primary studies exist. Pilot recovery did not support model selection; full cost projection did not admit the expanded study. No qualifying learned checkpoint or seed repeats.

requirements.original_target: Diagnose and report native correspondence precision, pose failure and perturbation robustness.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: The 192 positive rows correspond to 128 distinct camera and query conditions. Of 39 distinct full-library no-pose conditions, 38 had fewer than six matches under every template. Both query and exact-template p95 were 2 in the scarce subset, and 20/38 had at least 230 geometrically available patch centres. Prospective radiometric, terrain-warp and perturbation studies remain open.

requirements.original_target: Keep four calibration and twelve final terrain groups untouched during development. Preserve both consumed Tycho reserves as historical.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: The four calibration and twelve final terrain groups remain closed. Original LuSNAR 7–9, POLAR and orbital diagnostics remain open. A separate SPICE-HL3 native stereo-camera diagnostic has 24 exact timestamp-selected pairs on two traversals of one lab site. Its images and independent pose metadata are staged. No matcher has run on that data.
Two threads and native 512 remain binding. After the 3,182-second full cross-light reservation, original remaining allowances are 13,493 training and 35,879 baseline seconds.

requirements.original_target: Depth/visibility/frame/pixel-centre/crop-boundary/split/negative construction/cache and query-truth isolation checks; blank, nonoverlap, insufficient-match and degenerate-geometry controls.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: The fresh suite passed 1,202 tests with four skipped. New analytic Lambertian, native translated-image SIFT and common AP3P controls passed for the supplied-Sun module. The 384-case support audit opened metadata only.

requirements.original_target: Publish hashes for checkpoints, calibration rules, policies, preprocessing, cases and metrics before final inference; evaluate final reserve once.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: Final inference requires an eligible model and a published, one-time freeze.

requirements.original_target: Preserve match_terrain.py; localize_terrain.py accepts reference/query images, reference-only geometry/pose, intrinsics, frozen config/checkpoint and optional known-Sun metadata.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: Existing matcher and localizer interfaces remain available. A two-page interim brief presents the matched result and original evidence gates. Final release, full paper, full demonstration and outreach preparation still depend on measured qualifying results.

requirements.original_target: Specific integrated shared-Sun / learned response / active selection mechanism supported by measured localization gain and targeted prior-art comparison.
requirements.evidence_and_remaining_work: Published LIMA uses two reference illuminations and supplied Sun. Full cross-light pooling provides no pose gain in development. Correspondence scarcity and missing exact template effects are distinct measured mechanisms; prospective equal-budget experiments still need matched lunar evidence.

bounded_matched_development_result.raw_claim_scope: Shared-simulator development at catalogue lighting. It establishes a matched direct-control advantage, without an integrated compact superiority or state-of-the-art claim.
